methodology: We analyzed 60+ Reddit posts and 200+ comments across r/kohsamui, r/ThailandTourism, r/solotravel, and Facebook expat groups — spanning 2022 to 2026. Bars were cross-referenced with Google reviews, TripAdvisor rankings, and travel blog recommendations. We weighted responses from Koh Samui residents and long-term visitors more heavily than one-time tourist posts. Every bar was verified against current Google Places data for ratings, hours, and status.
